result.brief: 研究 DINOv2/DINOv3 等视觉基础骨干的稠密区域特征与 CLIP 文本嵌入之间的几何对齐缺口，并用视觉侧 LoRA 等适配手段修复该接口失配。
result.reason: Analyzes geometric misalignment between DINOv2/DINOv3 dense visual features and CLIP text embeddings, with visual-side LoRA adaptation—direct evidence on visual representation alignment and latent space compatibility.
